decks.identity: Turn death effects into returns, shields and lasting power.
Spread toxin, build a reaction, then turn cleansing into protection.
Pull enemies into traps. Make their position work against them.
Steal identities, exchange sides and rewind the board.

balls.quick: A stop becomes a new obstacle for both players.
balls.ability: On stopping, places a bumper near an arena edge. It rebounds both teams and survives five strong enemy impacts.
balls.condition: Needs free space; at most fourteen live structures. Friendly impacts do not damage your bumper.

balls.quick: Turn a gathered formation into a simultaneous attack.
balls.ability: On stopping, gathers allies within medium range and launches them along its last movement direction.
balls.condition: Rooted/frozen allies stay put. Crowded placements can be skipped. The launches spend no deck stock or extra player action.

balls.quick: The first strong enemy contact in an action adds a hit and a shove.
balls.ability: First strong enemy ball contact per action adds impact damage, outward force and a small recoil hit to Ram.
balls.condition: TOUCH and friendly contact do not trigger it. The advertised HTML structure bonus is disabled in that runtime and is not implemented here.

balls.quick: A straightforward ball. Aim well and let momentum do the work.
balls.ability: Unlimited stock. Launch it, collide with enemies and take control of the board.
balls.condition: Use an unused friendly ball in your home zone to Replay before your final spawn.

balls.quick: A friendly collision becomes a second chance to trigger a death effect.
balls.ability: Touch an ally to repeat its supported death effect while the ally stays alive.
balls.condition: Set up Cascade, Bonfire or another ally with a useful death effect, then make contact.

balls.quick: Bring an entire death engine to life without losing its pieces.
balls.ability: When it stops, repeats the death effects of up to three nearby allies.
balls.condition: Keep your effect-bearing allies close enough. The effect originates at each ally.

balls.quick: One burst hurts enemies and helps friends.
balls.ability: Its death effect damages and burns nearby enemies while healing nearby allies.
balls.condition: Agony or Requiem can repeat the effect without killing Bonfire.

balls.quick: The danger remains after the ball is gone.
balls.ability: Its death effect leaves a fire field that applies fire over three periodic ticks.
balls.condition: Place it where enemies will stay. This is a persistent field, not an instant explosion.

balls.quick: A wounded Soulburst has a stronger final word.
balls.ability: Its death effect damages nearby enemies; missing health strengthens the burst.
balls.condition: Repeat a wounded ally's effect with Agony or Requiem for a controlled payoff.

balls.quick: Give up health to bring an ally back.
balls.ability: Once, on stopping, spends 10 HP to revive an eligible fallen ally at 15 HP.
balls.condition: Needs more than 10 HP, an eligible grave and free space. The revive creates a Return event.

balls.quick: Each new return brings it closer to ancestry.
balls.ability: An allied Return advances it once per turn. Three qualifying turns grant its ancestral upgrade.
balls.condition: Three returns in one turn do not complete the upgrade. Pair with Cascade or Reclaimer.

balls.quick: Returning allies arrive with protection.
balls.ability: Grants shield to an eligible returning ally, once per target per turn.
balls.condition: Listen for Returns from Cascade or a revive. Ordinary removal does not count.

balls.quick: One ball can become a chain of smaller lives.
balls.ability: Its death effect creates a successor: the natural chain goes from 25 to 10 to 5 maximum HP, then ends.
balls.condition: Successors keep their lineage and trigger Return. They need free placement space.

balls.quick: Leave a place the enemy does not want to occupy.
balls.ability: On stopping, creates a pool that infects nearby enemies with toxin at turn end.
balls.condition: Use the infection to prepare Septic Core, Vector or Plague Leech.

balls.quick: Make an enemy's infection sustain you.
balls.ability: First enemy contact binds and infects its target. On its own turn, drains an infected linked enemy and heals itself.
balls.condition: The link needs a living infected enemy. Drain bypasses shield.

balls.quick: An infected enemy's death can start the next infection.
balls.ability: When an infected enemy actually dies, infects a nearby clean enemy, once per turn.
balls.condition: Consumption is not death. A clean eligible neighbor must be in range.

balls.quick: An infection is the beginning of the reaction.
balls.ability: Qualified hits against an infected target build Virulence. The second qualifying hit creates a burst.
balls.condition: Once per target per turn. Use separate turns; if the burst kills, Vector may spread the infection.

balls.quick: A safe area that turns patience into recovery.
balls.ability: On stopping, leaves a zone that periodically removes one negative status family from an eligible ally.
balls.condition: A genuine cleanse can trigger Absolver. The zone lasts three periodic ticks.

balls.quick: A relieved ally gains a little more protection.
balls.ability: Listens for allied cleansing and grants shield, once per target per turn.
balls.condition: Moving a debuff with Penitent is a transfer, not a cleanse. Ward or Consecrator supplies the trigger.

balls.quick: Carry the burden so another ball can keep moving.
balls.ability: Friendly source contact transfers the oldest active eligible debuff from the ally onto Penitent.
balls.condition: Already-held status families are skipped. Follow the transfer with a cleanse for an Absolver payoff.

balls.quick: Remove the danger, then add a shield.
balls.ability: On stopping, clears modeled negative statuses from nearby allies and gives baseline shield.
balls.condition: A genuine cleanse can trigger Absolver as well. This is not lasting immunity.

balls.quick: A single protected moment can preserve a setup.
balls.ability: Blocks its first kinetic damage instance.
balls.condition: Other damage types are not blocked. The protection is consumed by that first impact.

balls.quick: Turn an approach route into a trap.
balls.ability: On stopping, places up to four single-use nodes that root entering enemies.
balls.condition: Placement needs space. Root blocks pull forces, so pull the enemy toward a node before it is rooted.

balls.quick: A trapped enemy is a prepared target.
balls.ability: Qualified hits against rooted enemies gain extra damage.
balls.condition: A weak touch is not enough. Strike before the root expires.

balls.quick: Bring the closest eligible enemy toward your setup.
balls.ability: On stopping, pulls the nearest eligible enemy within range, once per turn.
balls.condition: Rooted enemies resist the force. Use the pull before Web's root triggers.

balls.quick: A quiet field becomes a violent surprise.
balls.ability: On stopping, arms a field. Enemy entry triggers an explosion at that visible field and destroys the mine.
balls.condition: The armed field stays at its placed location even if the ball is displaced.

balls.quick: Its death changes how the whole area behaves.
balls.ability: Death creates a growing black hole that pulls and consumes nearby balls. It ends after ten consumes.
balls.condition: It threatens both teams. Consume skips death effects and Return; Horizon Relay counts qualifying enemies.

balls.quick: A local disappearance can become pressure on the enemy base.
balls.ability: Every third qualifying enemy non-token consume damages the opposing base.
balls.condition: Ally and generated-token consumes do not charge it. Pair with a live black hole.

balls.quick: Change the route without changing the destination.
balls.ability: On stopping, places a linked portal pair. Entering balls emerge from the other portal with most of their momentum.
balls.condition: Both teams can use it. Recasting replaces the pair; the pair closes when Gatekeeper dies.

balls.quick: Reach past the nearest threat to move a distant target.
balls.ability: On stopping, pulls the farthest enemy within its long range toward itself.
balls.condition: Target order contrasts with Vinehook. Rooted enemies resist forces.

balls.quick: Enemy pressure becomes an ally's recovery.
balls.ability: On stopping, pulls nearby enemies and heals an eligible injured ally based on nearby enemy count.
balls.condition: A nearby rooted enemy resists the pull but still contributes to the healing count.

balls.quick: Take an opponent's ball identity for yourself.
balls.ability: Enemy contact copies its identity and turns the target into Standard. Both owners stay the same.
balls.condition: Choose the opponent carefully. Special-power availability depends on the copied ball in this demo.

balls.quick: Become another version of an enemy.
balls.ability: Enemy contact copies its identity and parameters without stripping the enemy's type.
balls.condition: The copied identity keeps its own mechanics. Special-power availability varies in the class demo.

balls.quick: A new identity, with no promise of what comes next.
balls.ability: On stopping, changes to a random visible nonunique special identity while keeping a rounded health ratio.
balls.condition: Draws from the full roster; some special powers are unavailable in this demo. A fixed result cannot be promised.

balls.quick: Every observed death can add another possibility.
balls.ability: Records current ball identities on death, then uses a collected signature when it stops.
balls.condition: Signature choice is random. This demo supports a subset of signatures.

balls.quick: A well-timed stop can repeat another ball's work.
balls.ability: On stopping, repeats nearby non-Echo stop effects on either team.
balls.condition: It may help the opponent too. Repeated effects need to be available in this class demo.

balls.quick: Exchange places and change the next encounter.
balls.ability: On stopping, swaps position with the nearest enemy in short range.
balls.condition: Position matters; the swap itself does not deal damage.

balls.quick: Leave yourself a way back.
balls.ability: Alternates between saving its state on stopping and restoring that saved state at a later stop.
balls.condition: The restore consumes its save. Nearby Echo can trigger the stop effect again.

balls.quick: The beginning of your turn remains an escape route.
balls.ability: Saves its state on its own turn and restores that retained state when it stops.
balls.condition: A rewind restores modeled health, position and statuses; it does not resurrect a dead ball or undo identity changes.

balls.quick: Capture an enemy at the cost of changing sides yourself.
balls.ability: Enemy contact exchanges ownership. Traitor becomes Standard on the opposing team.
balls.condition: Capture a useful stop-effect ball, then use Echo to trigger its new ally's ability.

balls.quick: A stopped Mine makes the next enemy touch dangerous.
balls.ability: Stopping arms Mine. A later enemy ball touch triggers a short-range explosion and consumes Mine. Frost can disarm it before contact.
balls.condition: Friendly contact does not trigger it. Its blast can damage and push both teams; replay disarms it until its next stop.

balls.quick: Set a visible fuse and make the opponent respond.
balls.ability: Stopping arms a two-own-turn fuse. The second own turn start detonates a medium-range blast and consumes Time Bomb.
balls.condition: Enemy contact does not trigger it. Every new STOP resets the fuse; destroying it early prevents its blast. Both teams can be hit.

balls.quick: Deliver an immediate area blast, at a cost.
balls.ability: Explodes in medium range when it stops, or if it dies first. The actual Bomb is consumed; one detonation never produces a second death blast.
balls.condition: Damages and pushes both teams. Agony or Requiem can repeat a living Bomb's death payload without consuming that Bomb.
